work_statement: STIGMERGY SCOUT — Nesting & Duplication Scan. Scan CT_VAULT/2026-04-28/ for structural issues: (1) docs with overlapping topics (use 07-codex terminology to detect topic drift), (2) nested folder redundancy (e.g., Templates/ contents should be ≤1-2 deep), (3) orphaned docs (no wikilinks TO them from 00-DASHBOARD), (4) incorrect routing (docs referencing investigation_labels that don't exist in 06-investigation-id-governance).
scan_checklist: [ ] Read 07-codex: identify all defined topics (mission, phase, task, bundle, step, artifact)
[ ] Scan CT_VAULT/2026-04-28/*.md: extract topic keywords from titles + frontmatter
[ ] Identify overlap: docs that cover same topic using different terminology (e.g., 'routing logic' vs 'compass navigation')
[ ] Check wikilinks: count backlinks TO each doc from 00-DASHBOARD; flag docs with 0 backlinks
[ ] Validate investigation_labels: cross-check against 06-investigation-id-governance for status (candidate/validated/active)
[ ] Check folder depth: Templates/, Droplets/ should be ≤2 levels deep
[ ] Verify braiding: ensure each doc has breadcrumb + related section footer per 09-vault-architecture

findings.suggested_fix: consolidate, delete, relink, or update per 10-vault-maintenance

manifest_decision.next_phase: Pass findings to vault-braiding-fixer-N scout for execution

constraints: DISCOVERY ONLY — Do NOT modify files. Log findings to manifest only.
Use 07-codex terminology consistently in findings (mission, phase, task, phase gate, etc.)
If doc is unclear, mark as routing_error (may indicate it should be merged or archived)
Prescan: if similar scan was done <24h ago, reference that manifest + only scan NEW docs
success_criterion: Identify 5+ structural issues + propose fix strategy. Quality score ≥0.70 (honest about ambiguous cases, not perfect omniscience).
